title: Filipino-inspired Smoked Beef Bourguignon
description: A twist on the classic French dish, incorporating smoky Filipino flavors.

ingredients.name: Kid-friendly vegetables
ingredients.notes: Chopped bell peppers, carrots, and potatoes

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef short ribs in batches until browned on all sides.
Remove the browned beef and set aside.
Add the onions and garlic to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the nduja and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, smoked Filipino BBQ sauce, and browned beef.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Add the kid-friendly vegetables and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.
